  Scenario: AC10 A statement that reaches a template row or a v_ace_* view is refused by the grant and fails the build (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb_treatment login holds the grants of section 12.7 only
    When a component or a test issues a statement against a template row or a v_ace_* view
    Then the grant refuses the statement, the boundary test fails the build and nothing is released
    Then no template row and no view row is returned to the caller

  Scenario: AC11 Every business rule of section 8 is named by a criterion or a test case (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rules BR1 to BR12 of section 8 and the test cases of section 16
    When the traceability check reads sections 7 and 16
    Then each rule BR1 to BR12 is named by at least one criterion or test case, and a rule with none fails the build

  Scenario: AC12 A request without a valid credential, without Documents C or outside scope is refused and writes nothing (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a request to POST /cases/{caseId}/generated-documents for treatment "TRT-0301" with no valid credential
    When generateContractDocument runs for treatment "TRT-0301"
    Then the answer is 401 with the problem body, message Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-S2-E2026-APP-AC17)
    Then a caller without Documents C gets 403 and a case outside the caller's scope gets 404, each with MSG-P4-002 or MSG-P4-003 as the guard answered
    Then nothing is read further and nothing is written

  Scenario: AC13 A generate call that does not answer inside 2 s is retried on the platform policy and writes nothing (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-document contract mock does not answer for treatment "TRT-0301" within 2 s
    When generateContractDocument runs for treatment "TRT-0301" and template "DIL-CONTRACT"
    Then nothing is stored, and the activity retries on the platform policy with a 1 s initial interval, back-off 2 and 10 attempts
    Then no document reference, no template version and no decision record is written on any attempt, and the treatment keeps the columns it had

edits.old: Three readings of the sources are stated here rather than hidden in the code.
edits.new: The document set and the signature sit with P5 rwb-document and P6 rwb-comms in the target: this story requests generation through the P5 contract, holds the document reference on the treatment, keeps no document content in `rwb_treatment`, and makes no review or signature request, which reach P5 and P6 only through their contracts (GAP-1704). The generation contract baseline fixes the path as POST /cases/{caseId}/generated-documents, names POST /documents/generate as the losing reading (ASM-115), publishes its event with five payload fields and no personal data or file byte, and treats the reads of other services as consumed and faked (GAP-1024). Three readings of the sources are stated here rather than hidden in the code.
